headline: Ghana Exports to China Reach $290 Million Under Zero-Tariff Access
summary: Ghanaian exports to China grew sharply following the rollout of Beijing's zero-tariff policy for eligible African goods, with imports from Ghana reaching $290 million in June 2026.
why: China has implemented preferential tariff arrangements for several African nations to deepen bilateral trade flows and secure commodity and agricultural supplies.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Duty-free market access to China provides a substantial boost to Ghanaian export volumes and foreign exchange receipts.
